scenarios.title: B｜想要的房型没有了
scenarios.setting: 在“电话预订房间 Making a Reservation by Phone”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“想要的房型没有了”。

turns.text: Good afternoon. How can I help you?

turns.prompt: 你想提出预订或预约需求，会怎么说？

choices.text: Hi, I’d like to book a room for two nights.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I’d like to book a room for two nights.
feedback.explanation: 用时间短语标明时点或持续时长，让对方能据此安排，而不只知道一个模糊的“晚点”。

words: Do you have a ... room available?
Do you have any other rooms available?
What other room types do you have?

choices.text: I’d like to make a reservation.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d like to make a reservation.
feedback.explanation: “reservation”指预订，指已经或准备安排的预约记录。

choices.text: I want booking a room.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I’d like to book a room for two nights.
feedback.explanation: “want”后接动作时需要“to + 动词原形”；提出服务需求也可以用“I’d like to …”，既补全结构，也更委婉。

turns.text: Certainly. What kind of room are you looking for?

turns.prompt: 你想询问自己偏好的房型是否有空房，会怎么说？

choices.text: Do you have a double room available?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do you have a double room available?
feedback.explanation: “double room available”是在问有没有可订的双人房；“available”把重点放在余房，而不只是酒店有没有这种房型。

choices.text: I’d like a double room, please.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d like a double room, please.
feedback.explanation: “double room”通常指配一张双人床的房间；若对床型有具体要求，还可进一步确认。

choices.text: Do you have a double room free?

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Do you have a double room available?
feedback.explanation: “free”能表示空着，但也可能让人想到免费；询问是否还有房可订时，“available”更明确。

choices.text: Do you have double room?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do you have a double room available?
feedback.explanation: “room”是单数可数名词，这里需要“a double room”；补上“available”还能明确是在问空房。

turns.text: I’m afraid all our double rooms are fully booked for those dates.

turns.prompt: 你想了解酒店还能提供哪些房型，会怎么说？

choices.text: Do you have any other rooms available?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do you have any other rooms available?
feedback.explanation: “available”指可获得或可使用的；询问服务时常指有没有余位。

choices.text: What other room types do you have?

feedback.naturalExpression: What other room types do you have?
feedback.explanation: 主动询问还有哪些选择，原方案行不通时仍能继续商量。

choices.text: Oh, that’s too bad. Do you have a twin room instead?

feedback.naturalExpression: Oh, that’s too bad. Do you have a twin room instead?
feedback.explanation: “twin room”指有两张分开的床的房间，区别于通常配一张双人床的“double room”。

choices.text: You don’t have double room?

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Do you have any other rooms available?
feedback.explanation: 口语能听懂这个反问，但缺少“a”；既然对方已说房型订满，接着问其他房型更能推进预订。

choices.text: Why you don’t have a room?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do you have any other rooms available?
feedback.explanation: 直接问原因要说“Why don’t you …?”，把助动词放在主语前；此处若目的是解决订房问题，问替代方案更有帮助。

turns.text: We still have twin rooms and deluxe king rooms available.

turns.prompt: 你想了解这项服务的费用，会怎么问？

choices.text: How much is the twin room?

feedback.naturalExpression: How much is the twin room?
feedback.explanation: “twin room”指有两张分开的床的房间，区别于通常配一张双人床的“double room”。

choices.text: What’s the rate for a twin room?

feedback.naturalExpression: What’s the rate for a twin room?
feedback.explanation: “twin room”指有两张分开的床的房间，区别于通常配一张双人床的“double room”。

choices.text: How much does the twin room cost?

feedback.naturalExpression: How much does the twin room cost?
feedback.explanation: “twin room”指有两张分开的床的房间，区别于通常配一张双人床的“double room”。

choices.text: How many money is the twin room?

feedback.naturalExpression: How much is the twin room?
feedback.explanation: “money”不可数，询问金额用“how much”，表示金额过多用“too much”，不搭配“many”。

turns.prompt: 关于「电话预订房间」，你想说明自己接下来能做什么或打算怎么做，会怎么说？

choices.text: Okay, I’ll take the twin room.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay, I’ll take the twin room.
feedback.explanation: “twin room”指有两张分开的床的房间，区别于通常配一张双人床的“double room”。

choices.text: That works for me. I’d like to book it.

feedback.naturalExpression: That works for me. I’d like to book it.
feedback.explanation: “would like”清楚表达需求，语气比直接说“want”更委婉，适合提出请求或表达偏好。

choices.text: No, thanks. I’ll try another hotel.

feedback.naturalExpression: No, thanks. I’ll try another hotel.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: Okay, I will take the double room.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay, I’ll take the twin room.
feedback.explanation: 前台提供的是“twin room”双床房；这里改说“double room”会把接受的房型说错。

learningGoals: Do you have a ... room available?
Do you have any other rooms available?
What other room types do you have?

scenarios.title: C｜想要的日期没有空房
scenarios.setting: 在“电话预订房间 Making a Reservation by Phone”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“想要的日期没有空房”。

turns.text: Good evening. Grand Park Hotel. How may I help you?

turns.prompt: 你想提出预订或预约需求，会怎么说？

choices.text: Hi, I’d like to book a room for this weekend.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I’d like to book a room for this weekend.
feedback.explanation: “would like”清楚表达需求，语气比直接说“want”更委婉，适合提出请求或表达偏好。

words: Do you have any rooms available from... to...?
Are there any rooms available on...?
Do you have anything available the following weekend?

choices.text: I’m calling to make a reservation.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m calling to make a reservation.
feedback.explanation: “reservation”指预订，指已经或准备安排的预约记录。

choices.text: I want reserve a room this weekend.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I’d like to book a room for this weekend.
feedback.explanation: “want”后接动作时需要“to + 动词原形”；提出服务需求也可以用“I’d like to …”，既补全结构，也更委婉。

turns.text: Certainly. What dates are you looking at?

turns.prompt: 你想说明日期、时长或时间上的需求，会怎么说？

choices.text: From Friday, October 16th to Sunday, October 18th.

feedback.naturalExpression: From Friday, October 16th to Sunday, October 18th.
feedback.explanation: “from … to …”把起止时间或范围一起说清，适合确认完整安排。

choices.text: October 16th to October 18th, for two nights.

feedback.naturalExpression: October 16th to October 18th, for two nights.
feedback.explanation: 用时间短语标明时点或持续时长，让对方能据此安排，而不只知道一个模糊的“晚点”。

choices.text: I want live October 16 to 18.

feedback.naturalExpression: From Friday, October 16th to Sunday, October 18th.
feedback.explanation: “want”后接动作时需要“to + 动词原形”；提出服务需求也可以用“I’d like to …”，既补全结构，也更委婉。

turns.text: I’m sorry, but we’re fully booked that weekend.

turns.prompt: 你想询问改换日期后是否有空房，会怎么说？

choices.text: Do you have anything available the following weekend?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do you have anything available the following weekend?
feedback.explanation: “available”指可获得或可使用的；询问服务时常指有没有余位。

choices.text: What about October 23rd to the 25th?

feedback.naturalExpression: What about October 23rd to the 25th?
feedback.explanation: 把安排作为共同商量的建议提出，方便对方接受、调整或补充。

choices.text: Are there any other dates available?

feedback.naturalExpression: Are there any other dates available?
feedback.explanation: “available”指可获得或可使用的；询问服务时常指有没有余位。

choices.text: You have room next weekend?

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Do you have anything available the following weekend?
feedback.explanation: 这类省略式问句能被理解；完整说法是“Do you have a room available next weekend?”，尤其适合电话交流。

choices.text: Why are you full?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do you have anything available the following weekend?
feedback.explanation: “full”能说明客满，但追问为什么客满带有质疑感；当前更有用的是询问其他日期是否有空房。

turns.text: Yes, we have several rooms available from October 23rd to the 25th.

turns.prompt: 你想确认新日期能否预订自己偏好的房型，会怎么说？

choices.text: Great. Do you have a double room available?

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. Do you have a double room available?
feedback.explanation: “double room available”是在问有没有可订的双人房；“available”把重点放在余房，而不只是酒店有没有这种房型。

choices.text: Perfect. I’d like to book a double room for those dates.

feedback.naturalExpression: Perfect. I’d like to book a double room for those dates.
feedback.explanation: “double room”通常指配一张双人床的房间；若对床型有具体要求，还可进一步确认。

choices.text: Okay. What room types are available?

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. What room types are available?
feedback.explanation: “available”指可获得或可使用的；询问服务时常指有没有余位。

choices.text: Great. I booking October 23rd.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. Do you have a double room available?
feedback.explanation: 进行时需要“am + 动词 -ing”，不能只说“I + -ing”；如果是在表达计划，也可改用“I’d like to …”。

turns.text: Yes. We have a double room for $120 per night.

turns.prompt: 关于「电话预订房间」，你想让对方了解你的需求或来意，会怎么说明？

choices.text: That works for me. I’d like to book it.

feedback.naturalExpression: That works for me. I’d like to book it.
feedback.explanation: “would like”清楚表达需求，语气比直接说“want”更委婉，适合提出请求或表达偏好。

choices.text: Great, I’ll take it.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great, I’ll take it.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: That’s a little expensive. Do you have anything cheaper?

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s a little expensive. Do you have anything cheaper?
feedback.explanation: 先确认有没有所需的物品、服务或安排，为后面的选择提供依据。

choices.text: No room October 16?

feedback.naturalExpression: That works for me. I’d like to book it.
feedback.explanation: 房间选择已经说明，再问有没有房会退回上一步；此时需要确认是否接受刚提供的方案。

learningGoals: Do you have any rooms available from... to...?
Are there any rooms available on...?
Do you have anything available the following weekend?

scenarios.title: D｜接受酒店推荐的其他房型 / 日期
scenarios.setting: 在“电话预订房间 Making a Reservation by Phone”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“接受酒店推荐的其他房型 / 日期”。

turns.text: I’m afraid our double rooms are fully booked, but we do have a twin room available.

turns.prompt: 酒店推荐了其他房型，你想了解条件或表达是否接受，会怎么说？

choices.text: That could work. Is there an additional charge?

feedback.naturalExpression: That could work. Is there an additional charge?
feedback.explanation: 先表示替代方案可以考虑，再确认是否需要额外付费，是很自然的回应。

choices.text: I’d be happy to take the twin room instead.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d be happy to take the twin room instead.
feedback.explanation: take ... instead 可以清楚表示接受替代房型。

choices.text: Okay, I take another room.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay, I’ll take the twin room instead.
feedback.explanation: 当场作决定通常用 I’ll take...，并明确说出 twin room 会更清楚。

turns.text: There’s no additional charge. Everything else in your reservation will stay the same.

turns.prompt: 你决定接受这个替代方案，会怎么确认？

choices.text: Great. I’ll take it.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. I’ll take it.
feedback.explanation: I’ll take it 是确认接受刚刚提出的房型或方案时非常常用的表达。

choices.text: That works for me. Please update my reservation.

feedback.naturalExpression: That works for me. Please update my reservation.
feedback.explanation: That works for me 表示你接受安排，随后请酒店更新预订，意思完整。

choices.text: Okay, I take it now.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但时态不自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Okay, I’ll take it.
feedback.explanation: 当场决定接受时应使用 I’ll take it，而不是一般现在时 I take it。

turns.text: Certainly. I’ve updated your reservation. We look forward to seeing you.
